project_type: Static client-only SPA: Vite 5 + React 18 + TypeScript (strict) + Tailwind CSS 3. React Router v6.30 BrowserRouter. No backend, rendered from local JSON data. Catholic apologetics resource ('Ave Christus Rex') the user shows on his phone during live debates.
build_system: Vite 5.4 (esbuild). npm. tsconfig strict, moduleResolution 'bundler', jsx 'react-jsx', resolveJsonModule true. PostCSS with tailwindcss + autoprefixer.
test_framework: None. There is no unit/e2e test framework in the repo. Verification is build + typecheck + static inspection of dist/.
test_command: npm run typecheck  (runs `tsc --noEmit`). There is no test runner.
verification_instructions: After each feature: run `npm run build` and `npm run typecheck` from the repo root; BOTH must exit 0. Then statically inspect dist/ (e.g. `ls dist`, read dist/index.html, grep dist/assets/*.css). DO NOT start a dev server (one is already running on port 5317 with strictPort, starting another fails). DO NOT kill the running dev server. DO NOT run `npm run preview` (also binds 5317). Check 360px no-overflow and both themes by reasoning about the compiled CSS/markup, not by launching a server.
snapshot_or_generated_files: PWA assets are generated at build time by vite-plugin-pwa into dist/ (sw.js, workbox-*.js) and are gitignored (dist/ is gitignored). PNG app icons pwa-192.png/pwa-512.png are generated once from public/favicon.svg by `node scripts/generate-icons.mjs` (uses sharp, already a devDependency) and committed to public/. apple-touch-icon.png (180x180), favicon.svg, favicon-16.png, favicon-32.png already exist in public/.
environment_constraints: A dev server is ALREADY RUNNING on 0.0.0.0:5317 owned by the orchestrator — never start or kill it; strictPort means a second server fails loudly. DO NOT change vite.config.ts server/preview host(0.0.0.0)/port(5317)/strictPort (a PWA plugin may ADD to plugins[] but these blocks stay). DO NOT edit src/data/content/** or .agents/research/** (a separate effort edits research JSON and may add a topic/arguments). DO NOT run git or commit. Everything must stay DATA-DRIVEN so later-added topics/arguments render with no code change.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md exists. README.md documents conventions. Keep TypeScript strict with zero type errors. Keep the ink/parchment/gold color system and Cormorant(serif)/Inter(sans) fonts. Use the brand name 'Ave Christus Rex' everywhere; NEVER reintroduce the old 'Ave Jesus Rex'. Update README.md to document new features.
key_patterns: Color via Tailwind utility classes on three custom scales defined in tailwind.config.js: ink (dark navy 50..950, DEFAULT #0f1724), parchment (warm off-white 50..900, DEFAULT #f5efe1), gold (amber 50..900, DEFAULT #c6a15b). Body is dark: `bg-ink-900 text-parchment-100` (src/index.css @layer base). Focus rings: global `:focus-visible` gold ring with ink-900 offset in index.css. Topic rendering is data-driven: TopicPage groups content.arguments by `category` using sectionOrder(declared, args) + a grouped Map, assigns each SectionHeader an id `section-<slugify(label)>`, and each ArgumentCard id={argument.id} with scroll-mt-24. Deep links /topic/<id>#<argumentId> are handled by a useEffect in TopicPage that scrolls + adds .search-flash (animation in index.css). Search index (src/search/searchIndex.ts) and nav/home/topic are all built from listTopics()/getTopicMeta() in src/data/topics.ts — the single registry. Strength is 'scriptural'|'strong'|'supplementary' rendered by StrengthBadge with per-strength classNames (gold solid / amber outline / muted slate).
